slots.notes: Hero-right glassy orb. Composited with mix-blend-screen to drop its black background and scale-125 to bleed off-center; brand-tinted to the primary CTA blue via a CSS color-grade filter.
Five filled stars in the 'Rated 4.9/5 by 2700+ customers' social-proof badge; tinted orange.
Arrow glyphs for the glassy navbar SignUp button and the white circular-arrow icon on the 'Get Started Now' primary CTA.
Five partner/company logos in the 'Trusted by Top-tier product companies' footer strip, rendered grayscale and spaced at gap-[100px].

mechanic: A static dual-column liquid-glass hero (sticky backdrop-blur glass navbar over a white layered-gradient-glow stage) whose signature motion is an autoplay-looping orb video color-graded and screen-blended into electric brand blue, plus a 1.02 hover scale on the primary CTA.
techDelivery: single-file React + Tailwind utility classes with arbitrary values (e.g. backdrop-blur-[50px], rounded-[16px], top-[30px]) and a React-attribute video tag (autoPlay loop muted playsInline)
reskinNotes: The orb's brand-blue look is a CSS filter (hue-rotate(-55deg) saturate(250%) brightness(1.2) contrast(1.1)) calibrated to the original PURPLE source asset AND depends on mix-blend-screen over a black-background video — swapping in a brand video with a different base hue or non-black background breaks the color grade and the compositing. Glow ellipse hexes (#60B1FF, #319AFF), star orange (#FF801E), and CTA/border rgba values are baked inline; CTA accent carries an 0.8 alpha plus backdrop-blur. Copy (headline, nav labels, rating text) is hardcoded in markup and layout assumes Fustat/Inter font metrics (75px / 1.05 line-height / -2px tracking).
